# The definition of "required for merge" for the vidra meta repo.
#
# scripts/ci/require-checks.sh reads this file in the `ci-required` job and
# fails unless every entry is satisfied for the commit under test. Configure
# ONE required status check in branch protection — `ci-required` — and this
# file becomes the single place the required set is declared and reviewed.
# TWIN: vidra-core, vidra-search and vidra-user carry the same file and job.
#
# Syntax (one check-run name per line, as GitHub reports it):
#   name    must EXIST for this commit and must conclude `success`
#   ?name   required only IF it ran (path-filtered lanes)
#
# Nothing but `success` passes: `cancelled`, `timed_out`, `neutral` and
# `skipped` all fail.

# meta-ci.yml — action pins, ignored env files, shell lint over every root,
# tests/ and deploy/ script, `node --check` over the smoke drivers, the
# install.sh unit tests, the deploy-script Python unit suites (with a skip
# failing the job), the Caddy pin, the migrator floor, and every compose render
# (full stack, hot-reload overlay, production overlay, port closure, image pins,
# config-key coverage, `vidra setup` answer coverage, bootstrap idempotency).
validate

# meta-ci.yml — the release bundle built twice and compared byte for byte, its
# schema version matched against migrations on disk, its contents checked, and
# the production matrix rendered from inside the extracted tree with no
# checkouts present.
bundle

# meta-ci.yml — the full stack booted in PRODUCTION mode from source, readiness
# probed, and BOTH migration one-shots run from the service images themselves.
boot

# NOT required — nothing else here runs on pull_request today.
